WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) AS col2
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(col2) AS col1
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.ID,
    step1.col2,
    step1.col2 - step2.col1 AS col3
  FROM step1, step2
  WHERE step2.col1 IS NOT NULL 
    AND step1.col2 > step2.col1
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(col2) AS col1
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    step3.ID,
    step3.col2,
    step3.col3,
    step3.col2 - step4.col1 AS col4
  FROM step3, step4
  WHERE step4.col1 IS NOT NULL 
    AND step3.col2 > step4.col1
)
SELECT 
  AVG(col2) AS avg_col2,
  AVG(col3) AS avg_col3,
  AVG(col4) AS avg_col4
FROM step5
